therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell DNA damage and apoptosis
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with advanced solid tumors including NSCLC, biliary tract cancer, and bladder cancer

results.effect_size: PFS: NSCLC 116 days (95% CI: 84-182), Biliary 128 days (95% CI: 86-181), Bladder 204 days (95% CI: 130-233)
subgroup_findings: Bladder cancer cohort showed longest PFS (204 days vs 116-128 days for other cohorts)
safety_signals: Cardiac events including cardiac arrest, cardiac failure
DLTs observed at 150 mg/m2 and above
results.dose_information: NC-6004 dose escalation from 60-180 mg/m2, with gemcitabine 1250 mg/m2 on days 1 and 8 of each cycle

context.duration: up to 40 weeks treatment, follow-up until progression
